page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; epigram in italic lines; then a heading and an italic verse passage; then a second heading and verse passage; a small signature mark at lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Illi etenim nullus poterit par viribus esse,

l.i: Cuius lene foret mox subitura iugum,
Finiit, ut potuit, gemitus: animisque receptis,
Istac fassa fuit commoda damna sibi,
Ergo age, quaprimum Herici fac, Sequana, Regis
Ad gelidas Arctos nuntia fama volet:
Hac Liger Hesperiis, Rheni Mosa dicito ripa,
Hac, Rhodane, ambustos perfer ad Æthiopas,
Vix Regem esse tamen: dubium quia fecerit ipse,
Rex patria dici debeat, unne pater.

main_text.l: Te, Michael, quodcunque malum tam lata
Coniugia, è tristi vix finit ire thoro.

page.notes: The first title line and the initial "T" of the last verse are decorated; the damaged letters in the second heading and the signature "L. 2." are doubtful. Some words in the italic verse are uncertain and may differ from the printed spelling.
